description: This file defines the 'Reward' model class within the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It manages reward/rettorno entities associated with projects, including retrieval, validation, persistence, and some business logic like availability and fulfillment checks.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Model representing a reward in a crowdfunding project, including properties, retrieval, validation, saving, and business logic related to reward management.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields that are language-specific for this model.

methods.name: setLang
methods.description: Sets language-specific data for the reward, extending parent behavior.

methods.name: isDraft
methods.description: Determines if the reward is considered a draft (not finalized or fully fulfilled).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a reward instance by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all rewards for a given project, filtered by type, fulfillment status, and icon.

methods.name: getSubscribableRewardsForProject
methods.description: Returns rewards that are marked as subscribable for a specific project.

methods.name: getRewardsOrderBySubscribableForProject
methods.description: Returns rewards ordered by whether they are subscribable and by amount.

methods.name: getWidget
methods.description: Fetches a limited set of rewards suitable for displaying in a widget.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates reward data before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the reward to the database after validation.

methods.name: updateURL
methods.description: Updates the URL field for the reward.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes this reward instance from the database.

methods.name: getTaken
methods.description: Calculates how many of this reward have been claimed.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Checks if the reward is still available for procurement (based on units and taken count).

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieves the associated project object.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns a string title representing the reward, combining amount and reward name.

methods.name: inInvest
methods.description: Checks if this reward has been chosen in a specific investment.

methods.name: icons
methods.description: Returns a list of icon objects of a specified type.

methods.name: licenses
methods.description: Returns a list of available licenses for rewards.

methods.name: areFulfilled
methods.description: Checks if rewards have been fulfilled for a project based on reward type.

methods.name: getChosen
methods.description: Retrieves rewards chosen by investors, with filtering, pagination, and count options.

methods.name: txtRewards
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of reward names associated with an investment.

methods.name: isMatched
methods.description: Checks if a reward has been matched via the MatcherRewardRepository.
